The idea is simple. Every day, one dress or fashionable piece of clothing will appear in this online shop. People can bid on it, and then the highest bidder will win the item for their price.

Where would the dresses come from? Student designers, unknown designers who want to make a name in the fashion industry. This is a plus because they won't just supply the product, they'll also tailor the product to the highest bidders needs, assuming it's possible. The supplier will also want to make as much money from their dress as possible, so they'll be encouraged to market it on their own social media, driving more traffic to the site.

I'm hoping the appeal of this site comes from the exclusivity of its product. Every day, people can check in to see what new dress is in stock, and since they're all supposed to be one of a kind, the people who care about originality will appreciate its uniqueness.

At first, the site might be slow, but eventually if it builds up, we could add more dresses a day. Like, maybe one dress in a petite size, and one auction could feature a plus size.

That's my very first pitch of this subverse! I am currently in the process of learning C#, so I do not have the programming capabilities to pull something like this off. I don't have any connections to fashion designers either, so that would definitely be a valuable trait in anyone who is interested in this idea. That is, if anyone is even interested in this idea! If you could think of a way it can be better, please let me know.
